Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Special

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Special
public class Special extends Object
Special-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_SPECIAL section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x09.
